text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Jeez, Trainer, you worry too much! Something like this is no big deal at all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But... *yawn*...
Looking at the bed's making me sleepy.
Just for a little bit... good night~☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~!! Chanko hot pot everywhere!!
Even a pot as big as a sumo ring!!
Amazing, amazing, it's a chanko wonderland~!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ooh, nice! Can I have a little taste test—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Suddenly my whole body feels hot...
And there's the smell of broth coming from me...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!?
C-Could it be that I...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Into chanko nabe... wait, huh?
I feel like I was just having a wonderful dream.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh, I don't really remember,
but sleeping made me hungry☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to cook dinner!
I'm gonna make a flavorful broth for the chanko nabe♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to a blissful dream,
Hishi Akebono's exhaustion seemed to vanish entirely.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
B-But forget wild vegetables,
there aren't any edible wild plants at all!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
There's no sea, no river... nowhere to be found!!
To think there's no food at all...!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, oh no...
What am I supposed to do when I get hungry!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ――Hah!! T-Thank goodness, was it a dream!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~, that was scary!
I never wanna have a dream like that again!
I gotta eat something tasty and forget all about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because of a nightmare,
Hishi Akebono's fatigue
lingered on...
